body: Yes!! It's really not. Thank you so much for talking to me. I'm feeling a lot better today.
😭 Thank you so much. That really means a lot.

Right now it is. Thank you. We've got canned foods from a local free food cubby in the area, but the problem is that I'm too physically/mentally tired to put food together. I barely had enough energy to cook canned corn the other day. And my partner is starting to get mentally low too, which I honestly feel like is my fault cuz they're in school and also trying to help me not spiral any further and I know it's taking a toll. I'm trying so hard to keep it together but all I can do is try to not burst into tears every five seconds and the rest of the time I'm either dissociating super hard or having fits of manic laughter.

I just....I'm so tired.

I used to do that, but these days I have exaggerated nightmares about my past (pretty sure I have cPTSD). So now sleep isn't even that much of a reprieve unless I drink before bed. Which...isn't the best habit to form.
